name: opencode
description: Installs a pinned opencode CLI and mounts host opencode config, agents, skills, and read-only auth with a persistent session volume.

version.description: opencode CLI version to install (pinned; avoid floating latest)

postCreateCommand: sudo mkdir -p /home/vscode/.local/share/opencode && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.local/share/opencode && if [ -f /mnt/opencode-auth.json ]; then cp /mnt/opencode-auth.json /home/vscode/.local/share/opencode/auth.json && chmod 600 /home/vscode/.local/share/opencode/auth.json; fi
